newsitem.title: USA: PaineWebber unit files $500 mln shelf debt.
newsitem.headline: PaineWebber unit files $500 mln shelf debt.

text.p: PaineWebber Mortgage Acceptance Corporation IV, a unit of PaineWebber Group Inc, filed a shelf registration on Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $500 million in asset-based certificates.
When combined with a previous registration, the PaineWebber unit will have up $644.9 million in those securities available for sale, according to the filing.

The certificates, to be sold in series, will represent ownership interest in a trust fund consisting primarily of a segregated pool of conventional one to four-family first mortgage loans to be sold by the PaineWebber unit.
The offering will be made through PaineWebber Inc, the brokerage unit of PaineWebber Group.
